name: Chandan
Giri
meta.title: AI Engineer & Researcher
meta.summary: AI Engineer and researcher, Smart India Hackathon 2025 National Finalist, with production experience at Sendlume. Currently building AI-native products at AMIPI and architecting DRISHTI-UGV, a ROS 2 autonomous navigation stack. Open-source contributor to projects including CodeGraphContext and sktime. Specializing in AI/ML pipelines, backend engineering and distributed systems.

bullets: Designed and implemented an AI-powered website auditing workflow for amipi.com that analyzes page performance, metadata, HTML structure, SEO and link integrity, surfacing missing metadata, structural HTML problems and broken or weak links.

Built an LLM-driven recommendation layer that turns raw diagnostic findings into prioritized, actionable optimization suggestions, automating website health monitoring so no one has to inspect every page and metric by hand.
Built AI-native products and autonomous multi-agent systems for business intelligence, strategy automation and content generation using LLMs, FastAPI, React and modern AI infrastructure.

Designed and developed an AI Strategy Intelligence Platform integrating trend discovery, knowledge management, agent orchestration and analytics to help businesses automate research, planning and decision-making.
Architected scalable backend services, AI workflows and production-ready APIs, working closely with leadership to turn business requirements into intelligent software products.

Founded an open-source educational AI infrastructure platform that automates the full examination lifecycle: exam management, rubric design, answer-sheet evaluation, grading workflows and academic analytics for institutions.

Architected a production-ready assessment engine using OCR, LLMs, explainable AI and distributed backend services to turn handwritten answer sheets into structured, auditable evaluations with transparent grading rationales and performance insights.
Led architecture of Sendlume’s AI workflow generation system, reducing LLM token costs from 3M to 20K (99% reduction) by redesigning prompt pipelines.
Designed and deployed a pixel-level email tracking microservice processing 10,000+ events/day with high reliability using invisible beacon technology and an async event queue.
Engineered an AI workflow canvas with a node-based visual interface backed by a stateless REST API, enabling non-technical users to design and deploy automation pipelines.
Built a real-time analytics dashboard using WebSocket streams and Redis-cached PostgreSQL aggregations, delivering live campaign KPIs with sub-100ms latency.
Maintained scalable DevOps infrastructure using Neon, Redis, Docker, improving system uptime and deployment efficiency.
